name: Process Utilities and Pipeline Design
description: Transportation and measurement of utilities like air, water, and steam. Handling of steam. Design of insulation for steam carrying pipes, water hammer. Design of flash tank. Advanced water treatment and reduction of fouling and scaling. Storage tank analysis for water. Piping network design, diagnosis, fittings, and valves. Air treatment: filtration and dehumidification, design of refrigeration and air-conditioning systems. Transportation of air: duct design, selection of blowers and compressors. Instrumentation and control for fluid transportation. Sustainable design and energy efficiency of industrial air and steam handling systems.
